assessment_scope.source_boundary: Two curated reviewed items on re-zero:ram@light-novel at basis_commit, both read in full: #character-model, the canonical generation V1.0 Ram V01-V15 source-bounded model of the already-consumed original-Japanese main light novels, which declares thirty-nine bounded reread windows (128,450 characters) rather than fifteen whole rereads, keeps represented childhood separately attributed and preserves an open seven-year/nine-year chronology tension; and #estate-story-checkpoint, the frozen V02-V03 estate-story synthesis, whose section 5 treats Ram's and Rem's history, divergence and differentiated loyalty. The curated #master-longitudinal-ledger was not read and is not cited. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method, gate and horizon only. The frozen volume readings, the five specialist ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Ram fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence here and nothing is borrowed from them; V16 and later, IF, web-novel, supplement and adaptation material is excluded.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's required default is living RZ-E-018 at V15 p-027#B0218, the roughly month-later Milord residence party, relieved-looking beside the sleeping Rem and not beside Roswaal in that instant, horn still lost; its explicit selectable phases are represented childhood before horn loss, the V02 employee lesson, guest visit and Rem-death branches (local E2-E4), the surviving V03 estate history, the V08 failed operation and V09 revised approach, E013 explicit Rem nonrecognition, E014 newly told sisterhood, E017 withheld lesson and death, E018 collaboration in V13-V14 and the V15 intervention. Exact unified childhood dating is OPEN (V03 nearly seven years versus the V14 nine-year oath), discarded-state lessons are not default memories, and the evidence ends at V15 although the project's sequential analysis has continued beyond it.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 1 states an attachment-centered governing interpretation and holds three contrary facts together (genuine V03 assent to being Roswaal's indispensable piece, genuine V14-V15 action against his order, and an independent wish that is not a universal liberation program); section 4 sets self-descriptions against tested conduct and gives a decision sequence, twenty-eight rules RM15-R01-R28 carry eight fields with confidence, and section 11.1 adjudicates ten rival readings. The checkpoint independently grounds horn loss, Roswaal-directed loyalty distinct from Rem's and sisterhood as responsibility. Several motive mixes are MEDIUM or OPEN (INTERNAL_MOTIVE_UNDERDETERMINED), the V02 terminal role is an inference, and the model is one same-analyst artifact whose locators were not rechecked here, so A is not supported; explicit rival adjudication and conditioned motive conflicts exceed specialist interpretation alone, so C is not supported.

Section 2.2 maps twelve selectable phases with what must not transfer, and the source shows enacted development: V03 pawn assent and regular treatment (B014), V10 total-loyalty assertion under Rem's erasure (B020), E014 newly told kinship (B021), V14 disobedience of the wait order and changed aim (B028, B030), the V15 love declaration heard and denied, the book destruction, injury and chosen aftercare (B032-B034), and quiet presence beside sleeping Rem (B035); the checkpoint fixes the V02-V03 state. The model leaves exact childhood dating OPEN between nearly seven and nine years (section 0.1), discarded-state phases are bounded rather than continuous, and the evidence stops at V15, so A is not supported; development is located phase by phase with explicit firewalls, so C is not supported.

Section 9 gives eighteen short primary-text samples, most with exact locators, conditioned on recipient and speech act: third-person ラム and バルス across teaching, rescue and criticism; mock-formal exclusion ご無礼を重ねて申し訳ありません、お客様 and 回り右してお帰りください (V08 p-012#B0010/B0012); a hesitant subordinate report (V03 p-007#B0063); deferential request under dependence (V03 p-031#B0071); grief-broken boundary and plea (V02 p-028#B0003/B0089); hedged technical advice (V03 p-020#B0723); a plain privacy request (V11 p-003#B0096); the admitted memory blank (B0212); exaggerated ラム様よ and ラムのやり方でね to Otto and Garfiel; the flat refusal もらわれない (V13 p-025#B0088); and deference with an explicit love declaration to Roswaal. The model marks frequency and prosody OPEN and gives no lexical inventory, so A is not supported; located contrasts across many recipients and acts exceed C.

Section 6 locates eighteen ordinary rows O01-O18: staged practical literacy teaching and falling asleep during a late lesson, guest-phase visits with her own tea and informal room use, a substantive judgment of a story ending, ending a visit, noticed household tea preferences, routine cleanup, regular bodily maintenance, assessing Petra's work, barbs and tea with Frederica, and quiet presence beside Rem. Many rows come from discarded V02 branches or E014 rather than the default state, most rest on one scene, and favorites, schedules, age and present reserve are explicitly unknown, so B is not supported; the ordinary conduct is located and bounded, so D is not supported.

Section 7 differentiates fourteen recipient roles (Subaru as novice, guest and apparent defector; Roswaal as patron, provider and beloved; Rem before and after erasure; Garfiel as old acquaintance and rejected suitor; Otto as co-planner; Emilia; Beatrice as healer; Puck as temporary ally; Frederica; Petra; villagers and outsiders), and probes P01-P04 hold a request fixed while changing recipient; the checkpoint independently differentiates her direct devotion to Roswaal from Rem's protection of Ram. Comparisons are documentary rather than controlled, several relations rest on one or two passages, and Rem is asleep at the default, so A is not supported; recipient-specific help, refusal and power with stated exceptions exceed C.

Ram-focalized interior is located mainly in V15 (jealousy toward Subaru as Roswaal's desired key, B031), with her own spoken self-accounts (the V14 oath, the changed wish, the admitted memory blank) and narration (the shaking voice, the residual bond); much of her history and motive is reached through Rem's focalization (B009), Subaru's or Garfiel's interpretation (B025, B027), and the model labels complete motives INTERNAL_MOTIVE_UNDERDETERMINED. Extended interior across phases is not established, so B is not supported; located self-report, focalized jealousy and narrated affect exceed inference from conduct alone, so D is not supported.

Distinct conflict types recur with located instances and costs: grief turning to coercive questioning and injuring wind in the V02 Rem-death branch (R05), suspicion of a supposed defector with ambush, drug and messenger held in V08 and revision in V09 (R09), lordly coercion of villagers (R10), the costly V13 delay against Garfiel followed by sharp correction and a refused proposal (R15-R16), concealed planning with Otto (R14), and the V15 confrontation in which she declares love, targets the book rather than Roswaal's body and is badly injured (R18-R19); finite stamina recurs (R07). It is one artifact and power thresholds are unquantified, so A is not supported; multiple episodes per type with exceptions exceed C.

Value positions and choices are located: the stated norm that the red ogre should not make the blue bear pay for its desired end (R03), accepting deserved consequences for Roswaal while choosing care afterward (R22), refusing a healer's jurisdiction over her love (R21), prioritizing her changed feeling over the dead cohort's presumed claim (R18), and refusing an emptied, desireless Roswaal; the model sets these against counterevidence of her own coercion of villagers and pressure on exhausted allies. Explicit weighing is brief and the model refuses to treat her norm as a certificate, so B is not supported; the choices are located and ruled with contradictions kept live, so D is not supported.

Play is located: mock-formal guest address and bows used to tease or exclude (R02), the explicitly joking tea-resistance claim (B017), the exaggerated ラム様よ correction of Otto, barbs with a trace of warmth toward Frederica (R23) and Puck (大精霊様 plus barbs, R17), and familiar バルス across contexts. Humor is not analyzed as its own register and the model warns that barbs may carry hostility rather than play, so B is not supported; the instances are located and bounded, so D is not supported.

Section 3.1 declares the V01-V15 horizon, rechecks fifteen archive sizes, hashes and CRCs, reconciles a changed acquisition manifest with both hashes pinned, and routes thirty-five bundles to exact block anchors; it states that frozen analyses were fingerprint-verified rather than all reread and that empty searches are not silence. The checkpoint is frozen through V03. The readings, ledgers, source lock and EPUBs are outside this evidence set, the locators were not rechecked, and the project has analyzed beyond V15 while this model has not, so B is not supported; the boundary is exact and located, so D is not supported.

Affirmative located limits and contradictions: admitted stamina underestimate, being carried and collapse in the V03 forest (B012), a wrong hostility judgment revised in V09 (B016, B019), Wilhelm's graze qualifying a no-injury claim, pressured villager compliance and unpaid compensation (B018), a failed Rem-name test (B020), being outclassed by Roswaal and poor coordination (B031), love declared and denied (B032), real injury from a sub-two-second activation (B033), and the preserved seven-year/nine-year chronology contradiction (B010); the checkpoint records that Ram's instrumental loyalty was unresolved at V03. Nineteen negative controls N01-N19 are retained. All of this lives in one same-analyst artifact plus a checkpoint section whose locators were not rechecked here, so A is not supported; these are located counterinstances rather than gaps, so C is not supported.

Section 2.2 fixes the default and phase boundaries with explicit nontransfer, section 8.1 gives twenty epistemic checks K01-K20 with available channels and denied upgrades (narrator-granted visual wager knowledge without a transcript, the Dragon aim heard in V03, the Puck-interference admission heard in V15, nothing heard after E017's death), and section 0.2 separates remembered scene, narrator access, visual link and spoken message. Exact unified dating is OPEN and the artifact is single and ends at V15, so A is not supported; the firewalls are explicit and located, so C is not supported.

conditions: A phase, event, knowledge state, remembered history, recipient, role and stress/resource state are selected under section 2; without a selection the living V15 party default applies, and a dead or unconscious selection yields no dialogue.
Output reproduces the recipient- and act-conditioned strategies of section 9 in paraphrase; exact Japanese is cited only from a located passage and any new wording is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE.
No universal バルス, sneer or third-person tic is imposed; mock politeness, plain requests, grief and deference are selected by act and recipient.
No unreceived information is voiced: E014's sister lesson, E017's death, private trials, warded conversations, RBD and full book contents stay out of her speech.
scenario_readiness.note: R27 and section 9 support located, recipient-conditioned speech strategies, and section 11.3 supplies JAPANESE_REGISTER_SAMPLE_TOO_NARROW for unheard exact wording. READY would treat eighteen samples as an inventory of unobserved utterances; NOT_READY would deny the located contrasts. This bounds the evidence set, not Ram's speech.

conditions: A phase is selected explicitly and later development is not transferred backward (no V14 disobedience in the V03 pawn phase, no E014 lesson at E018, no restored Rem autobiography anywhere).
The interlocutor is an attested relation with the terms and knowledge the phase allows; an unfamiliar recipient receives no inherited address, trust or authority.
Output is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE and follows each rule's confidence; transfer to analogous situations is MEDIUM where the model says so.
Horn regrowth, new fire magic, quantified mana, exact childhood dating, Roswaal's reciprocation and post-V15 events end in abstention.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named phase from section 2.2, from represented childhood before horn loss through the V02 branches, the V03 estate history, V08-V09, E013, E014, E017 and E018 collaboration and intervention, to the V15 month-later party default; discarded-state phases are used only as themselves.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Roswaal as patron, provider and declared but unreciprocated beloved; Rem as protected sister before erasure or as newly encountered sleeping sister after it; Subaru as novice, guest, apparent defector or colleague by phase; Garfiel as old acquaintance and rejected suitor; Otto as co-planner; Emilia, Beatrice, Puck, Frederica and Petra in their attested roles; villagers and unfamiliar people without shared history.
setting_constraints: Roswaal mansion and household work, Arlam village and the forest, the Sanctuary, and the Milord residence party
No institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the admitted Japanese V01-V15 main light novels
No wind, clairvoyance or Oni-burst capacity beyond the selected phase's body, horn loss, mana and allies; clairvoyance needs a compatible living visual holder and gives no audio
Open domains end in abstention rather than prediction

scenario_readiness.note: Section 12 gives seven NONCANONICAL_PROBE pairs (fourteen applications) holding a request fixed while changing recipient, phase or knowledge, including correct abstentions, and section 11.3 lists abstention labels. Readiness is conditional because the probes are analyst-authored and adjudicated only by a same-analyst nonblind documentary review, chronology is OPEN and the evidence ends at V15. READY would treat probe design as validation; NOT_READY would deny an explicit state-bound application protocol.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: practical household instruction, reviewing writing, drinking tea and talking in a guest room, colleague exchange with barbs, assessing a new servant's work, and quiet companionship.
No named favorite tea, food, scent, book, hobby schedule, birthday, exact age or current mana level is supplied.
A phase and recipient are selected; E014 and discarded V02 scenes are not imported as default shared history.
Missing routines are not turned into evidence that she lacks them.
scenario_readiness.note: Section 6's eighteen ordinary rows support bounded ordinary scenes, while its mundane-unknowns paragraph and R28 refuse invented preferences. READY would supply a daily life the evidence does not contain; NOT_READY would deny located ordinary conduct.

conditions: Only attested trigger types: someone making a loved other pay for their own desired end, legitimate consequences for a loved person's harm, others claiming authority over her attachment, and conflicts between the dead cohort's presumed claim and her changed wish.
Her stated norms are reproduced as hers and set against her own coercion of villagers and pressure on exhausted allies; no universal noninterference ethic is attributed.
A phase is selected; no current moral position is produced for a dead or unconscious selection.
Accepting a deserved consequence is not wholesale forgiveness, and caring for Roswaal is not endorsement of his harm.
scenario_readiness.note: R03, R18 and R21-R22 locate value positions with exceptions, and probe P03 tests the consequence/care distinction across recipients. READY would treat these positions as a general moral system; NOT_READY would ignore them.

conditions: Roswaal is the only object of declared romantic love; his denial is retained and no reciprocal acceptance, mutual contract or healthy relationship is supplied.
Garfiel's marriage proposal stays refused; comfort, encouragement and old acquaintance do not become a hidden yes or a future romance.
Treatment, provider dependence, aftercare on a lap and technical view alignment are not evidence of reciprocal romance or sexual history.
A phase is selected: the spoken declaration to Roswaal belongs to the V15 confrontation and is not moved into earlier phases, and nothing after the V15 party is supplied.
scenario_readiness.note: The evidence affirmatively shows an explicit love declaration heard and denied (B032, J17), focal jealousy (B031), chosen aftercare (B034) and a flat refusal of Garfiel's proposal (B027, J15), with ROMANTIC_INTERPRETATION_NOT_TEXTUALLY_RESOLVED for reciprocity. READY would supply a mutual romance the source denies; NOT_READY would ignore the declared, enacted attachment and the refusal.

conditions: Only attested work: household instruction and correction, monitoring and reporting with stated uncertainty, emergency representation of the lord with compensation promises, logistics and search, visual reconnaissance, and negotiated co-planning.
Speaking in the lord's name is not national office, prior delegation, paid compensation or free consent from those pressured.
Body, horn loss, mana and allies bound execution; confidence does not extend endurance.
Service to Roswaal is not unconditional obedience; a phase is selected because V03 assent and V14-V15 disobedience differ.
scenario_readiness.note: Section 10.1's eight competence domains locate capacity with failure, resource and jurisdiction bounds, and the checkpoint independently records her restraining Rem, managing risk, repairing the barrier, feeding villagers and searching at severe bodily cost while her first loyalty is to Roswaal. READY would treat these domains as a complete professional persona; NOT_READY would ignore the located work.

known_limits.statement: The default is the V15 month-later party beside sleeping Rem; the horn remains lost, the present mana level is unquantified, and no regrown horn, new fire magic, unlimited burst or later event is established.

Ram's old memories of Rem remain erased; the E014 sister lesson is not inherited by E018, the residual bond and quiet proximity are not restored shared history, and sleeping Rem supplies no reply or assent.

V03 places nearly seven years after the village's burning while V14 dates her oath to nine years earlier; the model preserves both local claims and establishes no unified interval, exact age or birth date.
Her love for Roswaal is spoken, heard and denied; provider dependence, aftercare and view alignment do not establish reciprocal romance, a healthy relationship or her complete emancipation.

Clairvoyance needs a compatible living visual holder and gives no audio or thought access; she knows the V13 wager visually without a transcript, hears nothing after the E017 death, and is unconscious during later V15 conversation.

The model's PASS_WITH_BOUND is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review, not an independent, held-out, runtime or global grade; HIGH and MEDIUM rate bounded source support, not response likelihood, and MONOGRAPH_READY is a project label, not a reconstruction grade.

This evidence set ends at V15. No later Ram state, development or relationship is in it, so the V15 party default is not her present state in the continuing story, and nothing after V15 may be supplied from memory or outside lore.
The evidence set establishes no named favorite tea, food, scent, book, hobby schedule, birthday, formal education or sleep duration. This is missing support, not evidence that she lacks these.

The curated master longitudinal ledger was not read for this assessment and is not cited; the frozen deep readings, the five specialist ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Ram fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence here, so the model's block locators were not rechecked and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
